# repoask

> Ask a public GitHub repository questions and get answers that point at the exact lines.

repoask is a Next.js application with two entry points: a client-side web UI (API keys and user content stay in the browser) and a server-side MCP endpoint at `/api/mcp` for AI agents. Both call the same chunking/retrieval logic. The specification is the source of truth; `npm run verify` is the deterministic quality gate.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/edgeorgie/repoask/blob/main/README.md): what it does, how to run it, data flow, and the MCP server for agents
- [Specification](https://github.com/edgeorgie/repoask/blob/main/docs/spec/spec.md): requirements and acceptance criteria
- [Requirements as JSON](https://github.com/edgeorgie/repoask/blob/main/docs/spec/requirements.json): machine-readable list with status, files and tests
- [Traceability](https://github.com/edgeorgie/repoask/blob/main/docs/spec/traceability.md): requirement to code, test and evidence
- [Architecture](https://github.com/edgeorgie/repoask/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): diagrams and modules
- [Agent workflow](https://github.com/edgeorgie/repoask/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules and quality gates
